rules: Power plants from the Global Integrated Power Tracker, then OpenStreetMap and the Global Power Plant Database for plants the tracker does not list. A plant shows from the year it started until the year it retired; plants without a start year are not drawn. The capacity of a plant is the sum of its operating units.
Two records of the same technology are one plant when their names and numbers agree and they lie within 15 km, or when one has no name and they lie within 4 km.
Installed capacity and the electricity mix are national figures from Ember. In the newest year the mix covers the newest 12 months.
The lenses Power capacity and Solar and wind capacity add up the operating plants with a known capacity.

vintage.plants: Global Energy Monitor, Global Integrated Power Tracker, 2026-09 release.; OpenStreetMap extract 2026-11-27; Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021-06)
